prompt: Build a TagIndex: a Map whose values are Lists, so one tag can hold many items. Unknown tags must return an empty list rather than null, and an item is never filed twice under the same tag.
explanation: A "multimap" is just a Map<String, List<String>>, and the whole trick is creating the inner list the first time a tag is seen: get returns null, so you make a new ArrayList and put it back before adding. Storing the map as a TreeMap keeps the tags sorted for free, while each ArrayList keeps its items in insertion order. Returning a fresh empty list for an unknown tag keeps callers from having to null-check.
hints: index.get(tag) returns null when the tag has never been used -- that is your signal to create a new ArrayList and put it in the map.
Guard against duplicates with items.contains(item) before adding.
A TreeMap keeps keys sorted, so tags() can simply return index.keySet(), and size() is index.size().
